notes.title: Closed Beta Underway

Hello everyone,

All chosen applicants for the Neptunia™ Virtual Stars Closed Beta have been contacted! Thank you for everyone who applied. If you were not selected for this closed beta, do not worry! We will have more closed betas for our future titles soon!
